dataset: GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis surface currents, sea-surface height and mixed-layer depth, DAILY, 0.25 degrees — family 7.2d

grid.align: point — row r is latitude -90 + 0.25 r, column c is longitude -180 + 0.25 c (family 7's g025 grid)

qc_policy: GLORYS12 publishes no per-value flag. NaN over land, under ice shelves and south of 80 S (rows 0..39, outside the reanalysis). `log_mld` is log10 of a positive depth, NaN otherwise. A value outside its sanity bounds becomes NaN and is counted, never clipped; the January-2015 probe counted none.
